name: Tenra: private money tracking for the new year
description:
Tenra is a private money tracker for iPhone by a solo developer in Kazakhstan. It keeps every account in one place without a bank login: records stay on the device, the backup goes to the person's own iCloud Drive.

Payments record themselves. An Apple Pay payment becomes an expense through a Shortcuts automation, and on iOS 27 Tenra reads bank push notifications the same way, so cards of any bank are covered. A purchase can also be spoken, typed, scanned from a receipt or imported from a PDF statement.

Beyond expenses: deposits with daily interest, loans with a payment schedule, subscriptions, goals, debts, homes and cars with net worth, several currencies. Ten, the assistant, answers questions about the person's money.

Native to iOS 26 and 27: Liquid Glass, App Intents and Siri, Home and Lock Screen widgets, a Control Center control. 12 languages, Kazakh among them.

January is when people decide to take control of their money. Tenra lets them start without a bank password.
notes: An update is planned for the last week of December. Daily tracking, budgets, subscriptions, goals, analytics and Apple Pay capture are free; Tenra Pro adds deposits, loans, assets, voice, statement import and the assistant without a limit, with a 14-day trial on the annual plan. No ads, no tracking across apps, no analytics SDK.
